items.title: Pete Jolly interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999
items.q: there were a lot of different record dates with all kinds of different artists. Dean Martin, Bing Crosby, through the year.

ctx.x: You’ve played some significant little piano riffs then.
I’m trying to think of the list of — you get my bio out — but there were a lot of different record dates with all kinds of different artists. Dean Martin, Bing Crosby, through the year.
Do you get statements from the union from the Recording Manufacturer’s Society or whatever, about things that you’ve played on and you get royalty or residuals?
